rootCauses.title: content-availability filters by item file only
rootCauses.detail: filterLocalizedCalculators/hasLocalizedCalculatorContent require locales/<locale>/calculators/items/<slug>.json. Used by catalog hubs, search, related block, sitemap.

rootCauses.title: Most RU item files are orphaned after schema deletion
rootCauses.detail: Commit caad87e deleted base EN schemas for area-circle, area-rectangle, cube-root, exponent, gcd, lcm, logarithm, inflation-adjustment (and others). RU item files and .ru.json overlays remained but are not registered.

rootCauses.title: TypeScript RU definitions ignored by availability filter
rootCauses.detail: percentage-of-a-number and loan-payment have full RU CalculatorDefinition in data/calculators.ts but no locales/ru items file, so they are hidden from RU catalog/search/sitemap.

rootCauses.title: Silent catch in registry loader
rootCauses.detail: JSON read/parse failures in LocalCalculatorLoader.getAll/getByCategory are swallowed, masking broken schemas.

rootCauses.title: Direct RU URLs for missing items still 200 with English fallback + noindex
rootCauses.detail: Confirmed on production for mortgage-calculator; orphans like /ru/calculators/math/gcd return 404.
